paragraphs: Chapter 683
Episode 174. Bale's Misunderstanding (3)
Jin, Valeria, and Hedo could only be speechless for a while.
The madman, once known as a knight of Runcandel, recognized Sandra as Sarah to the very end.
"Hehehe! At first, I thought he was a monster who kept hitting our Jin, but he turned out to be a good friend, didn't he?"
Sandra completely ignored Bale's actions of denying her identity.
From her point of view, as long as she stopped him from attacking Jin and even helped him, nothing else mattered.
"...... Miss, are you alright?"

"Yeah, as you can see, I'm perfectly fine. My hands and feet, which got bruised while fighting that guy, are all healed now. Wow, he was really tough. I don't think my fists and feet hurt this much even when I was hitting Hedo hard."
Hedo couldn't hide his troubled expression, like a middle-aged man in a crisis.
A minor curiosity led him to be disarmed and put Sandra in danger.
Moreover, the fact that he secretly contacted the Vamel Alliance during his vacation was revealed to the family.
If the monster that awoke from the seabed didn't suddenly show such extreme favoritism towards Sandra, he would have floundered and lost everything.
Although he hasn't actually lost anything yet, Hedo was feeling a sense of defeat for the first time in a long time.
"Miss, you need to give him one more order."
"What order?"
"Tell him not to attack the family, the Vamel Alliance, and Kinzelo. Looking at his behavior, I think he'll definitely accept your command for now."
"Oh, that would be necessary. Hey! Only attack the Garden of Swords! Ah, he's already breaking everything?"
At her words, Hedo calmly adjusted his broken glasses and took out a cigarette from his trouser pocket.
Even before Bale began to act, a significant number of Zipfel's warships had been shot down by the Red Ray of the Graveyard Giant.
[Sarah, what?]
"Attack only those who came from the Garden of Swords, Runcandel!"
[I'll try my best!]
"......It seems like we won't have much to say when we return to the family. All of this is my fault, miss."
"What are you talking about all of a sudden?"
"It means that I put you in danger, miss. Upon our return to the family, you and I will be subject to intense investigation."
"It's not the first time, is it?"

"This time is different. It appears that you and I secretly colluded with the Vamel Alliance, leading to a loss of the family's power in the process. As a key power, I won't be a problem, but you will definitely lose your freedom. You'll become a hostage to prevent my betrayal."
"That Bale guy looks like he'd fight the entire family if they touch me. Hedo would do the same."

"That's hard to take seriously. We don't know when he'll realize that you're not Sarah Runcandel, and in a situation where the abomination is blatantly gaining power, it poses various problems for me and the family to be in conflict."
"Can't we just run away until my father's anger subsides?"
"Miss."
"Why?"
"First of all...... it might be better to reconsider after the situation is over."
Jin's eyes widened.
This was because Hedo's words hinted that he might betray Zipfel.
Jin did not add anything more. Whatever decision he made, Jin was determined to intervene as much as he could.
The one who had helped in the search for the old heritage of Runcandel was in trouble. Naturally, Jin had to take responsibility.
[Phew, I can't believe I've forgotten that madman. The manipulation of history is indeed scary.]
Quikantel spoke as she escaped from the melee in the sky and descended to the seabed.
Fortunately, Bale did not attack her.
However, it wasn't because he still had loyalty to Runcandel or memories of the old times, but merely because Quikantel was a familiar face.
"Miss Quikantel."
As Quikantel transformed into a human, her comrades naturally stood nearby. Seeing that everyone was safe, Jin let out a sigh of relief in his heart.
"Jin, as you can see, that guy is not a human, but a divine being."
"From the way he fights, it doesn't seem like he became strong through training."

"That's right, Bale was strong from the beginning...... and he couldn't control that power, causing big problems all over the world. Countless people must have died by his hand. In those times, Runcandel didn't originally recruit Bale, but considered him a target for subjugation."
"How did such a person become one of the Ten Knights?"
"Because of Sarah. I can't remember the exact process, but Bale swore allegiance not to Runcandel, but to Sarah, and Temar appointed Bale as one of the Ten Knights to repay the world for his sins."
"Certainly...... if controlled, it would be a tremendous help."
Jin said, looking up at Bale.
His fighting style was definitely different from that of humans.
First of all, he could fight in the air using his two wings, and the power pouring out from his sword and body was not aura or magic, but a divine power.
The energy of the blue thunder that had dyed the sky was already being replaced by Bale's golden divine power.
The scale of his power was so vast it wouldn't be strange to say it was close to creating a world. The depth didn't follow suit, but neither was it shallow like weapons that only have massive energy.
Every time his wings flapped, a storm spread out, and the sky struck down golden lightning following the trajectory of his sword.
The beam fired from his eyes was so powerful it made the cemetery giant look frail, and every time he moved, the sea turned upside down.
It was as if an angry god was directly engaging in battle.
Moreover, some chaos dragons burst into pieces simply by the closing of Bale's outstretched hand in the empty air, without even making direct contact.
"The problem is, the fact that this guy was buried here is because he was not under control."
"Because of Sarah's death?"

"Exactly. Until Sarah died, he had a restraint on himself. Without Sarah's command, he could not exert any power. When the restraint was in place, he looked like a normal human. The restraint was lifted as soon as Sarah died."
This means that unless another restraint is placed, Bale is a ticking time bomb, unpredictable when he might explode.
The likelihood of him turning hostile as soon as he realizes the real Sarah is dead is too high.
"......And he was expelled from the Ten Knights. He destroyed the world every day in a rampage."

"We should decide what to do with Sir Bale after verifying the records through Aria. Since our forgotten memories are coming back just by Sir Bale waking up, it would be good if the conclusion is in the direction of preserving his life as much as possible."
If he can become an ally, it would be more than reassuring.
Above all, Bale seems to have little memory loss, except for his perception of Sarah, so he could play a key role in tracking the past.
[Padler! You couldn't stop Sarah from reaching that point, and you couldn't stop yourself from falling apart. Don't you feel miserable?]
[Shut up, Bale.]
[Every time Sarah defended you, a coward, it made my teeth chatter in disgust.]
[I've forgotten all those who claimed to be my comrades at the time. But as soon as I see you, I remember you clearly. When Temar was destroying my kingdom... you were standing by his side.]

[Looking at it, you couldn't protect not only Sarah and you but also your kingdom. I remember regretting that I couldn't show you the whole process of the moon collapsing. Now you're clinging back to Runcandel, prolonging that pathetic life? You're also rejected by Sarah.]
[That's an inspiring story. There's a woman named Sarah down there, unlike me, you'll be able to verify the entire process of her death.]
[The mouth that used to act noble finally shows its true nature. Go ahead, I wish you bad luck.]
Words filled with hatred and swords were exchanged between them.
At one point, they were both part of the Ten Knights and had roamed the battlefield together. Although he had never seen this scene before, Jin felt a bitter taste rising in his heart.
The hatred they feel for each other likely stems from the death of Sarah.
Sarah's death, in turn, probably originated from the defeat of Runcandel.
If he were to lose in this life, he felt the Vamel alliance and his companions would end up like them, becoming spectral beings who horrifically despised each other.
With those thoughts in mind, Jin decided to change his approach to Bale, who he initially thought to dispose of after verifying the records.
'I will make him an ally at all costs. If he can't become a true comrade, I will turn him into a controllable weapon.'
Not only Bale, but even the Elona Zipfel that Talaris had sealed, he decided to make them all usable.
Kwizijijit-!
A sharp bolt of lightning struck Bale's forehead.
After blocking the lightning with his wings, Bale laughed as if he found it amusing.
[With such power, you're going to kill me? I find your little minions more annoying.]
Stam and Lionel were being repelled by Bale's sword.
Bale was strong, but Padler, Stam, and Lionel were significantly weaker than when they faced Jin in the Sword Garden.
This wasn't a ground battle. While the three of them were fighting on an unstable stance, stepping on the sea surface, Chaos Dragon, and Black Line, Bale was completely dominating the sky.
It wasn't long after the battle started that Bale seemed to have a significant advantage.
Padler's group also knew why they were at a disadvantage.
But the reason they couldn't rashly pull Bale into the seabed where they could fight fully is simple.
It was because Jin was standing below them.
Moreover, considering their allies nearby, especially Hedo, who was not an easy opponent, they decided that it was better to fight a disadvantageous battle in the air.
[Today is a special day, Padler. It's the moment when Sarah will be completely freed from you......]
Soon, Bale, who had plunged into the sea, grabbed Padler's neck that had just sprung up.
Padler's eyes bulged in anger, and Bale wore a smile thinking he would finally finish him off. But soon, Bale's expression twisted.
[What, are you trying to run?]
Padler's body was gradually fading.
Jin and his companions thought the Prophetess was reclaiming his soul.
But the one who was summoning Padler back to the Sword Garden was not her, but Rosa Runcandel.
Through Padler's eyes, Rosa was looking down at the seabed with a smile.
